table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode,   
         packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
         accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
         address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2,
			CITY=dbo.customer.city,  
			PHONE=dbo.customer.phone,   
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno, 
			headerinvno=dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,  
         date = Case :ai_printdate When 1 Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate When 2 Then dbo.saleledger.date When 3 Then dbo.saleledger.Billingdate  End, 
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = saledetail.batch,   
         expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
         looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
         bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
         packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
         packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
         saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
         discperc = saledetail.discperc,   
         salestax = saledetail.salestax,   
			itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,  
         Id = dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=saleledger.posted,   
         balance=0,   
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
			dbo.saleledger.remarks,
			dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
			dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
			saleledger.printbalance,			
			messagedesc=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode),
			salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			reprintcounter=saleledger.reprintingcounter,
			serverdate=getdate(),
			salecatcode=saleledger.salecatcode
    FROM saleledger,   
         saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  
   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode> = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode < = :ar_lInvCode ) AND  
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ar_custcode) )AND 
         ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
ORDER BY 
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
			dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) + c_amount

objects.name: t_previousbalance
objects.visible: 1	if( posted ='N' AND printbalance='Y' and salecatcode<>3,1,0)

objects.name: c_balance
objects.visible: 1	if( posted ='N' AND printbalance='Y' and salecatcode<>3,1,0)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.visible: 1	if( posted ='N' AND printbalance='Y' and salecatcode<>3,1,0)

objects.name: t_14
objects.visible: 1	if( posted ='N' AND printbalance='Y'  and salecatcode<>3,1,0)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.visible: 1	if( posted ='N' AND printbalance='Y' and salecatcode<>3,1,0)
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: t_28
objects.visible: 1	if( posted ='N' AND printbalance='Y' and salecatcode<>3,1,0)

objects.name: compute_7
objects.visible: 1	if( posted ='N' AND printbalance='Y' and salecatcode<>3,1,0)
objects.expression: ABS(Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) + balance)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  for group 1)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)   for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for  group 1)  *  (1 -invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) + c_amount for group 1)
